text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: About Ryuji-san... Why did the village chief make him wear something that makes him look like a Suspicious Creep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
リュウジさんなんですけど……
村長さんは、
どうしてあんな
へんたいふしんしゃさんみたいな格好にしたんでしょう？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Well... The village chief said something like that, but it doesn't seem very cute or lovely to me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん……
村長さんもそんなことを言ってましたけど、
あんまりぷりちーにも
らぶりーにも見えません……

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: I-I mean...! I kind of thought the same thing, but you should be a bit gentler with your words!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その、
あの……！
私もそんな気はしてたんですけど、
もっと優しい言い方をしないとダメですよ！？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Would people have been more scared if he wasn't dressed like that? It's true, if Ryuji-san kept his usual outfit but spoke the same way, I might have found him intimidating.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あんな格好じゃなかったら、
みんなもっと怖がってた？
確かに、
リュウジさんが普通の格好のままで
あの話し方だったら、
怖いって思っちゃったかもしれません。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: The village chief probably had his reasons. Thank you for explaining it to me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
村長さんなりに、
気遣ってのことだったんですね。
教えてくれて、
ありがとうございました♪
